ArchiveSourceFailure.description: ArchiveSourceFailure names an archive that gave no answer. It carries no URL.

httpStatus.description: Upstream HTTP status for http-status failures; 0 otherwise.

BillingVerificationError.description: Returned with HTTP 503 when paid access cannot be confirmed right now: the billing provider is re-verifying a recently expired subscription, or the entitlement backend is unreachable. Retryable — honor Retry-After.

code.description: Machine-readable billing-verification state, mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header.

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint, when the denial came from a tier gate.

CatalogDay.description: CatalogDay holds the elements fetched on one UTC day; past passes use the day nearest each pass.

fetchedAt.description: When that day's elements were fetched, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

ConfirmedChangeFlag.description: ConfirmedChangeFlag is a change in radar statistics at a site that a second comparable scene confirmed.

datetime.description: Time of that scene, ISO 8601 UTC.

geometryKey.description: Acquisition geometry the baseline is specific to: constellation, relative orbit, direction and mode.

itemId.description: Archive item of the scene that confirmed the change.

updatedAt.description: When the flag record last changed, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

wording.description: Always "imagery statistics changed": the flag reports that statistics changed, not what changed.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

ForbiddenError.description: Returned when a PRO-gated endpoint denies access because the caller has no resolved authenticated user, entitlements cannot be verified, or the caller lacks the required entitlement tier.

code.description: Machine-readable denial code, present when the 403 is a billing-provider-confirmed subscription lapse (mirrored in the X-Billing-Verification response header).

requiredTier.description: Minimum entitlement tier required for this endpoint.

GatewayError.description: Returned by gateway infrastructure errors before an RPC handler runs, such as origin, routing, method, authentication, or quota checks.

error.description: Gateway error reason or structured gateway failure details.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, upper case, e.g. "UA".

GetCountryImageryEvidenceResponse.description: GetCountryImageryEvidenceResponse is a country's watched-site satellite evidence.

asOf.description: Evaluation time of the country's least recently evaluated site, as Unix epoch milliseconds; 0 when nothing is served.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

confirmedFlagCount.description: Sites with a confirmed change flag.

siteCount.description: Watched sites in the country; 0 for a country with none.

stale.description: True when the evidence is missing or older than its freshness limit; sites is then empty.

GetPointPassesRequest.description: GetPointPassesRequest names a point on Earth. Both coordinates are required and are rounded to 0.01 degrees before anything is computed.

GetPointPassesResponse.description: GetPointPassesResponse lists imaging passes over the rounded point for the last 7 days and the next 72 hours, with the archive images matched to them.

archiveStatus.description: "complete" when every archive answered, "partial" when one failed and the passes it serves keep geometry tiers.

catalogFetchedAt.description: When the orbit elements were fetched, as Unix epoch milliseconds; 0 with no catalog.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

computedAt.description: When the passes were computed, as Unix epoch milliseconds; past and future are judged against it.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

inventoryVersion.description: Version of the sensor-profile inventory used.

outOfFootprintPasses.description: Passes in range whose footprint misses the point; they are counted, not listed.

stale.description: True when the orbit catalog is missing or older than its freshness limit.

items.description: Missions whose every archive failed, so their passes could not be confirmed or ruled out.

windowEndMs.description: Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

windowStartMs.description: Search window, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

ImageAcquisition.description: ImageAcquisition is one archive acquisition at the point. Overlapping tiles and copies of one acquisition count once.

cloudCoverPct.description: Scene cloud cover in percent, for optical acquisitions that report it.

endMs.description: Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

imageUrl.description: Public image of the acquisition: a crop around the point when the archive can render one, else a whole-scene preview; empty when neither exists.

items.description: Archive item ids that make up the acquisition.

orbit.description: Relative orbit, or the Landsat WRS path; 0 when unknown.

passNoradId.description: NORAD id of the pass that produced it; 0 for an image no computed pass explains.

passTimeMs.description: Time of that pass, as Unix epoch milliseconds; 0 when unmatched.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

profileId.description: Sensor profile: sentinel-2, sentinel-1 or landsat.

startMs.description: Sensing span, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

ImagingSatellite.description: ImagingSatellite is a profiled satellite with its newest orbit elements.

profileId.description: Id of the SensorProfile the satellite belongs to.

InvalidRequestBodyError.description: Returned when a JSON POST request body is empty or malformed.

JmespathProjectionError.description: Returned when a REST jmespath projection is invalid or exceeds the expression/output byte limits.

original_keys.description: Top-level keys or shape of the unprojected response.

ListImagingSatellitesRequest.description: ListImagingSatellitesRequest takes no filters: the catalog is one small shared document.

ListImagingSatellitesResponse.description: ListImagingSatellitesResponse is the imaging catalog. With no catalog stored, the lists are empty and stale is true.

fetchedAt.description: When the current elements were fetched, as Unix epoch milliseconds; 0 with no catalog.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

inventoryVersion.description: Version of the sensor-profile inventory below.

stale.description: True when no catalog is stored or the stored one is older than its freshness limit.

OmmElements.description: OmmElements is one set of published OMM mean elements, in CelesTrak's GP fields.

epoch.description: Element epoch, ISO 8601 UTC as published (no zone suffix means UTC).

raOfAscNode.description: Right ascension of the ascending node, degrees.

OrbitalPoint.description: OrbitalPoint is a point in decimal degrees.

PointPass.description: PointPass is one pass of a profiled imaging satellite whose footprint covers the point.

acquisitionKey.description: Key of the archive acquisition this pass produced; empty when none matched.

category.description: Sensor category, e.g. open-optical, open-radar, weather-polar, commercial-radar, military, crewed-station.

coverage.description: True when the mission acquires over this point at all (land and coasts for the open missions).

edgeOfSwath.description: True when the point is within 5 km of the footprint edge, so whether it was imaged is uncertain.

elevationDeg.description: Elevation of the satellite seen from the point, degrees.

groundDistanceKm.description: Ground distance from the sub-satellite point to the point, km.

incidenceDeg.description: Incidence angle at the point, degrees from vertical.

opportunity.description: True for a future pass: a chance to image, never an image.

orbitAgeDays.description: Days between the pass and the epoch of the orbit elements it was computed from.

profileId.description: Id of the sensor profile the satellite belongs to.

side.description: Side of the ground track the point lies on, facing the direction of travel: "left" or "right".

sunElevationDeg.description: Sun elevation at the point at pass time, degrees.

tier.description: One of confirmed-image, likely-imaged, within-reach, capability-overhead, daily-mosaic, passed-overhead, opportunity.

tierNote.description: "not-in-archive" when the archive answered without this pass after its publication delay; empty otherwise.

timeMs.description: Time of closest approach, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

RateLimitError.description: Returned when a gateway or handler rate limit rejects the request.

SensorProfile.description: SensorProfile is one row of the published inventory of imaging-satellite families.

category.description: One of open-optical, open-radar, weather-polar, commercial-optical, commercial-radar, military, crewed-station, geostationary.

items.description: Operator documentation the row is taken from.

SiteImagingWindow.description: SiteImagingWindow is the next pass expected to image a watched site.

SiteObservation.description: SiteObservation is the newest archive scene of a watched site.

profileId.description: Sensor profile: sentinel-2, sentinel-1 or landsat.

UnauthorizedError.description: Returned when the API key is missing, malformed, or lacks current API access.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

WatchedSiteEvidence.description: WatchedSiteEvidence is the satellite evidence for one watched site.

evaluatedAt.description: When the site was last evaluated, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

items.description: Operators whose satellites passed over the site in the evaluation window.
Registry lists the site comes from.

ApiKeyHeader.description: Alias header for the WorldMonitor API key (X-WorldMonitor-Key).
ApiKeyHeader.name: X-Api-Key

get.description: GetCountryImageryEvidence returns a country's watched sites with their newest scene, next imaging window and any confirmed change flag. Requires a subscription.

parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, upper case, e.g. "UA".
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.description: Optional JMESPath expression applied server-side to project or reduce the JSON response before it is returned (mirrors the MCP jmespath argument). Invalid expressions, expressions larger than 1024 UTF-8 bytes, or projections that exceed the 256 KB output cap return HTTP 400 with a {_jmespath_error, original_keys} envelope. Grammar and worked examples: https://www.worldmonitor.app/docs/mcp-jmespath.
parameters.name: jmespath

403.description: API access requires an active subscription (the API key's subscription is inactive or expired).

X-Billing-Verification.description: Present when the 403 is a billing-provider-confirmed subscription lapse (value subscription_lapsed, matching the body `code`).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying the request.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the active rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the active rate-limit window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the active rate-limit window resets.

503.description: Service unavailable. Billing-verification responses include code and X-Billing-Verification; other gateway infrastructure failures use the generic GatewayError shape.

X-Billing-Verification.description: Billing-verification state that produced this response (matches the body `code`).

X-RateLimit-Mode.description: Present with value degraded when a fail-closed rate-limit dependency is unavailable.

X-Validation-Mode.description: Present with value degraded when user API-key validation is temporarily unavailable.
